voice_performance.performance_intent: Captions are the voice. Punchy, mute-first, one claim per cut.
voice_performance.energy_curve: Hook slam → view stack → detector reveal → takedown → leftover TikTok sting
voice_performance.pause_policy: Hard cut between beats. No VO pauses.

sections.label: Hook — $26
sections.text: Twenty-six dollars a video. That's the gig rate.
sections.speaker_directions: On-screen: $26 / A VIDEO / THAT'S THE GIG RATE

sections.label: Machine — actors + scripts + views
sections.text: Real actors. AI scripts. Forty-five million YouTube views. Plus millions more on TikTok.
sections.speaker_directions: On-screen: REAL ACTORS / AI SCRIPTS / 45 MILLION / YOUTUBE VIEWS

enhancement_cues.description: View-card stack; 45 MILLION is the glow card

sections.label: Loophole — real faces
sections.text: The detector hunts fake faces. So they hired real ones. A real face beats every AI label.
sections.speaker_directions: On-screen: THE DETECTOR / HUNTS FAKE FACES / SO THEY HIRED / REAL ONES
sections.source_ref: research_brief.data_points[3] TNW Sep 4 — real face beats synthetic-media detectors

sections.label: Takedown — spam not lies
sections.text: Semafor published. Twenty channels gone. For spam. Not lies. YouTube took them down this week.
sections.speaker_directions: On-screen: SEMAFOR PUBLISHED / 20 CHANNELS / GONE / FOR SPAM. NOT LIES.
sections.source_ref: research_brief.data_points[2] Semafor Sep 3 — YouTube terminated 20 channels for spam

sections.label: Sting — still on TikTok
sections.text: The clips still live on TikTok. September 2026. The loophole was a person.
sections.speaker_directions: On-screen: THE CLIPS / STILL LIVE / ON TIKTOK / SEPT 2026
sections.source_ref: research_brief.data_points[5] TNW / Riddance — TikTok recirculation after YouTube takedown
